Scope: Typed post-commit recovery and current-revision reconciliation; no durable persistence certification

AuditFindings.PagePublication: CreatePageAsync and UpdatePageAsync commit the authoritative page revision before category indexing is invoked
AuditFindings.PostCommitIndexing: Non-success indexing outcomes are logged and do not roll back or falsify the already successful page response
AuditFindings.ExistingRetry: No retry or reconciliation operation existed before this milestone
AuditFindings.RaceRisk: An older post-commit attempt can be superseded by a newer page revision unless current revision is re-resolved before replacement
AuditFindings.Atomicity: No shared durable transaction or outbox exists; this remains an explicit limitation

ConfirmedDefects: Missing typed consistency/recovery state for post-commit outcomes
No explicit authorized current-revision reconciliation operation
ImplementedComponents: ReconcileAsync on the existing application-service boundary
Unknown classification for applied results without durable read-back
Structured consistency/recovery logging after page publication

RecoveryPolicy.Current: Only reported when membership read matches authoritative revision and desired set; not inferred from Applied alone
RecoveryPolicy.Pending: Never synthesized; requires a future authoritative operational mechanism
RecoveryPolicy.Stale: Current revision evidence or replacement conflict shows supersession
RecoveryPolicy.Incomplete: Incomplete extraction preserves existing membership and prevents replacement
RecoveryPolicy.Unavailable: Rejecting repository or required persistence boundary unavailable
RecoveryPolicy.Unknown: Insufficient durable evidence, including Applied without read-back

Reconciliation.RevisionChangeBeforeReplacement: Rejected by second authoritative source resolution

OutcomeMapping.Applied: Unknown unless durable read-back exists; eligible for a new authorized reconciliation
OutcomeMapping.NoChange: Current when repository membership read matched the current desired set
OutcomeMapping.IncompleteExtraction: Incomplete; eligible only after dependency/source recovery and new authorization
OutcomeMapping.RevisionConflict: Stale or superseded; requires current revision

RemainingLimitations: No durable consistency history or Pending state
No automatic retry scheduling or outbox
No category MVC or production migration readiness
